```{r}
behrules <- list(
  cue = c("Red", "Yellow", "Green", "Blue"),
  rsp = c("Up", "Down", "Left", "Right")
)

key_names <- c("cue", "rsp")
# 检查colnames的元素名称是否一致
check_key <- all(sort(names(behrules)) == sort(key_names))
if (!(check_key)) {message("Invalid behrules keys")}
# 检查colnames的元素类型是否一致
check_type <- all(sapply(behrules, is.character))
if (!(check_type)) {message("Invalid behrules key type")}

methods::setClass(
  Class = "multiRL.behrules",
  slots = list(
    cue = "character", 
    rsp = "character"
  )
)

multiRL.behrules <- methods::new(
  Class = "multiRL.behrules",
  cue = behrules$cue,
  rsp = behrules$rsp
)

record <- matrix(
  data = NA_real_,
  nrow = length(input@n_trial) * length(input@n_block) + 1,
  ncol = length(multiRL.behrules@cue)
)

colnames(record) <- multiRL.behrules@cue

methods::setClass(
  Class = "multiRL.record",
  slots = list(
    input = "multiRL.input",
    behrules = "multiRL.behrules",
    record = "matrix"
  )
)

multiRL.record <- methods::new(
  Class = "multiRL.record",
  input = input,
  behrules = multiRL.behrules,
  record = record
)

```
